title: Multimodal Models (CLIP)
description: Multimodal modeller: Görüntü ve metin gibi farklı modaliteleri birleştiren AI sistemleri. CLIP (OpenAI) ile zero-shot image classification, image-text retrieval. Contrastive learning, vision-language pretraining. GPT-4V, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion'ın temeli.

content.level0_basic: Multimodal Models (Çok Modaliteli Modeller), farklı veri tiplerini (görüntü, metin, ses, video) birlikte işleyen AI sistemleridir. En ünlü örnek: **CLIP** (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training - OpenAI). CLIP, görüntü ve metni aynı uzayda temsil eder. Örnek: 'Bir kedi fotoğrafı' metni ile kedi görseli yakın, köpek görseli uzak. Zero-shot classification: Eğitilmediği kategorileri bile tanır. GPT-4 Vision, DALL-E 3, Midjourney'in temelinde CLIP var.
content.level1_beginner: CLIP'in temel prensibi: 400M görüntü-metin çiftini contrastive learning ile eğit. **Contrastive learning**: Eşleşen (görüntü, metin) çifti yakın, eşleşmeyen uzak olsun (embedding space'te). İki encoder: (1) **Vision Encoder** (ResNet veya ViT - Vision Transformer): Görüntü → embedding, (2) **Text Encoder** (Transformer): Metin → embedding. Eğitim: Batch'teki N görüntü, N metin → N² çift, N tanesi doğru eşleşme, geri kalan N²-N yanlış. Loss: InfoNCE (contrastive loss). Inference: Zero-shot classification - 'a photo of a {class}' template'leri embedding'e çevir, görüntüye en yakın olanı seç. Avantaj: Yeni kategorileri eğitim olmadan tanır.
content.level2_application: CLIP uygulamaları geniştir: (1) **Zero-shot Image Classification**: ImageNet'te eğitilmeden %76 accuracy (supervised %88). (2) **Image-Text Retrieval**: Google Images gibi, metinle görüntü ara veya görüntüyle metin ara. (3) **Text-to-Image Generation**: DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion - CLIP guidance ile 'a cat wearing a hat' → görüntü. (4) **Visual Question Answering**: 'Bu resimde kaç insan var?' (5) **Video Understanding**: Frame'leri CLIP'le encode et, temporal modeling ekle. (6) **Multimodal Embeddings**: E-ticaret product search (ürün görseli + açıklama). Modern evrim: **BLIP**, **ALIGN** (Google), **Florence** (Microsoft), **LLaVA** (vision-language chatbot). GPT-4V = GPT-4 + vision encoder (muhtemelen CLIP-benzeri).
content.level3_advanced: İleri seviye multimodal modeling, architecture variants, training strategies ve limitations içerir. **Architecture**: CLIP vision encoder: ResNet-50/101 veya ViT-B/L/H (Vision Transformer daha iyi). Text encoder: 12-layer Transformer (GPT-2 benzeri). Embedding dim: 512-1024. **Training**: WebImageText dataset (400M çift, internet'ten scrape). Batch size 32K (çok büyük!), contrastive loss her GPU'da local + global. Data augmentation: Random crop, color jitter (görüntü), BPE tokenization (metin). **Prompt Engineering**: 'a photo of a {class}' vs 'a centered satellite photo of a {class}' (domain-specific) → %5-10 accuracy farkı. **Fine-tuning**: Linear probe (freeze encoders, sadece classifier eğit) vs full fine-tune. **Limitations**: Text reasoning zayıf (counting, spatial relations), fine-grained details (texture, small objects), compositional understanding ('red car next to blue house' - attribute binding).
content.level4_expert: Expert seviyede, multimodal research frontiers, scaling laws ve production systems önemlidir. **Scaling**: CLIP model size (ViT-L/14 vs ViT-H/14), dataset size (400M → 2B+ LAION), compute (V100 × 256 GPU, 12 gün) → performance sürekli artar. **Architectural Improvements**: (1) **BLIP** - bootstrapping ile caption quality artır, (2) **ALBEF** - momentum distillation, (3) **CoCa** - contrastive + captioning dual loss, (4) **Flamingo** - few-shot learning (frozen vision encoder + cross-attention). **Unified Models**: **GPT-4V** (vision + language chat), **Gemini** (Google - native multimodal), **LLaVA** (CLIP + LLaMA). **Video Understanding**: **VideoMAE**, **TimeSformer** - temporal modeling. **3D Multimodal**: **ULIP** (3D point cloud + text). **Audio-Visual**: **AudioCLIP** - ses + görüntü + metin. **Production Challenges**: Latency (vision encoder inference 50-200ms), embedding storage (milyonlarca görüntü × 512 dim), approximate search (FAISS, Milvus). **Bias & Safety**: CLIP internet'ten öğrendi → stereotypes, NSFW content, misinformation. Red-teaming, content filtering, fairness evaluation şart.

whatIsIt: Multimodal Models, farklı modalitelerdeki (görüntü, metin, ses, video) veriyi ortak bir representation space'te birleştiren AI sistemleridir. **CLIP** (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training), görüntü ve metni aynı embedding space'te temsil eder: $\mathcal{L} = -\log \frac{\exp(\text{sim}(I_i, T_i) / \tau)}{\sum_{j=1}^N \exp(\text{sim}(I_i, T_j) / \tau)}$ (InfoNCE loss). Vision encoder $f_v: \mathbb{R}^{H \times W \times 3} \to \mathbb{R}^d$ (ResNet/ViT) ve text encoder $f_t: \text{tokens} \to \mathbb{R}^d$ (Transformer). Eğitim: 400M görüntü-metin çifti, batch'te eşleşen çiftler yakın, eşleşmeyenler uzak (contrastive). Zero-shot: Yeni task'leri eğitim olmadan çöz.
whyNeeded: Multimodal models kritik çünkü: (1) **Zero-shot Generalization**: Eğitilmediği kategorileri tanır (costly annotation gereksiz). (2) **Cross-modal Understanding**: Görüntü ile metin arasında ilişki (Google Lens, Pinterest visual search). (3) **Text-to-Image**: DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion - CLIP guidance. (4) **Visual AI Chatbots**: GPT-4V, LLaVA - 'Bu resimde ne var?' (5) **E-commerce**: Product search (görsel + text query), visual recommendation. (6) **Accessibility**: Görme engelliler için image captioning, screen reader. (7) **Content Moderation**: NSFW detection, misinformation (deep fake). (8) **Scientific Discovery**: Medical imaging (X-ray + report), satellite imagery (görüntü + geo-tagging).
realWorldAnalogy: Multimodal models'i çok dilli bir tercümana benzetebiliriz. Normalde bir model sadece İngilizce konuşur (sadece görüntü işler), başka bir model sadece Türkçe (sadece metin işler). Ancak **CLIP** her iki dili de bilen bir tercüman gibidir: Görüntüyü 'görsel dil'den okur, metni 'sözel dil'den okur, ikisini de ortak bir 'anlam uzayı'nda anlar. Örnek: Size bir kedi fotoğrafı gösteririm, CLIP 'kedi' der. Size 'a photo of a cat' metni veririm, CLIP aynı 'anlam uzayı'nda aynı noktayı gösterir. Bu sayede: (1) Hiç görmediği bir kategoriyi (örn: 'ördek') metin olarak tanımlarsam, fotoğrafta tanır (zero-shot), (2) Bir görüntü verip 'buna benzer metinleri bul' diyebilirim (retrieval), (3) Bir metin verip 'bunu çiz' diyebilirim (DALL-E). Tercüman hem kitap okur (metin), hem resim anlar (görüntü), ikisini birbirine çevirebilir!

formulas: \text{Zero-shot Classification}: \quad P(y=c|x) = \frac{\exp(\text{sim}(f_v(x), f_t(\text{'a photo of a '} + c)) / \tau)}{\sum_{c'} \exp(\text{sim}(f_v(x), f_t(\text{'a photo of a '} + c')) / \tau)}

stepByStep: 1. **Dataset Hazırlığı**: Web'den görüntü-metin çiftleri topla (alt text, captions). CLIP: 400M çift (WebImageText). Filtreleme: NSFW removal, language detection (English). Data augmentation: Random crop, flip, color jitter (görüntü).

2. **Model Architecture**: Vision encoder seç (ResNet-50 veya ViT-B/L/H). Text encoder seç (12-layer Transformer, BPE tokenization). Projection head: Her encoder'ın output'unu ortak embedding dim'e project et (örn: 512 veya 1024).

3. **Contrastive Learning Setup**: Batch size N (büyük olmalı: 256-32K). Her batch: N görüntü, N metin. Positive pairs: (I_i, T_i) - i. görüntü ile i. metin eşleşir. Negative pairs: (I_i, T_j) for j≠i - N²-N adet.

4. **Forward Pass**: Vision encoder: I_i → embedding v_i ∈ ℝ^d. Text encoder: T_i → embedding t_i ∈ ℝ^d. L2 normalize: v_i, t_i → unit vectors (cosine similarity için). Similarity matrix: S[i,j] = v_i · t_j (N×N matrix).

5. **Loss Hesaplama**: InfoNCE loss: Her görüntü için doğru metin'i N metin arasından seç (classification), her metin için doğru görüntüyü N görüntü arasından seç. Temperature τ ile scale. Symmetric loss: (image→text + text→image) / 2.

6. **Backpropagation & Update**: Loss'u minimize et, her iki encoder'ı güncelle. Optimizer: AdamW, learning rate schedule (warm-up + cosine decay). Batch size çok büyük → distributed training (multi-GPU, gradient accumulation).
7. **Training**: Epochs: 32 (400M veri, batch 32K → ~400K iterations). Checkpoint: Her epoch model kaydet. Evaluation: Zero-shot ImageNet accuracy, retrieval metrics (Recall@1, @5).

8. **Zero-shot Inference**: Class labels: ['cat', 'dog', 'bird', ...]. Prompt engineering: 'a photo of a {class}'. Text encode: Her class için embedding. Görüntü encode: Test image → embedding. Cosine similarity: Görüntü embedding ile her class embedding arasında. Prediction: argmax similarity.
9. **Fine-tuning (opsiyonel)**: Linear probe: Freeze encoders, sadece linear classifier eğit (hızlı). Full fine-tune: Her iki encoder'ı task-specific data ile eğit (yavaş ama daha iyi).

10. **Production Deployment**: Model serialize (ONNX, TorchScript), inference optimize (TensorRT, quantization), embedding database (FAISS for retrieval), API endpoint (image upload → classification veya retrieval).
algorithm.complexity: **Zaman Karmaşıklığı**: Vision encoder (ViT-L/14): O(N·d² + P²·d) (N=patches, P=patch count, d=embed dim), ~150ms/image (GPU). Text encoder: O(L·d² + V) (L=sequence length ~77, V=vocab ~50K), ~10ms/text. Training: O(Iterations · BatchSize · EncoderCost), 400M data, batch 32K, 256 GPU → 12 gün. **Inference**: Single image classification: 150ms (vision) + 10ms×K (text for K classes) + similarity O(K·d). Retrieval: 1M images, FAISS ANN O(log N), <100ms. **Uzay**: Model: ViT-L/14 ~400M params (~800MB), embeddings: 1M images × 512 dim × 4 bytes = 2GB. **Scalability**: Distributed training (DDP, FSDP), mixed precision (fp16/bf16), gradient checkpointing.

codeExamples.title: CLIP Zero-Shot Classification
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import clip
from PIL import Image

device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model, preprocess = clip.load('ViT-B/32', device=device)

image = Image.open('cat.jpg')
image_input = preprocess(image).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

labels = ['cat', 'dog', 'bird']
texts = [f'a photo of a {label}' for label in labels]
text_inputs = clip.tokenize(texts).to(device)

with torch.no_grad():
    image_features = model.encode_image(image_input)
    text_features = model.encode_text(text_inputs)
    image_features /= image_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    text_features /= text_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    similarity = (100.0 * image_features @ text_features.T).softmax(dim=-1)
    values, indices = similarity[0].topk(3)

for i, (value, idx) in enumerate(zip(values, indices)):
    print(f'{labels[idx]}: {value.item()*100:.2f}%')
codeExamples.explanation: CLIP zero-shot: Hiç eğitilmediği kategorileri tanır. Görüntü ve text'i embedding'e çevir, cosine similarity hesapla.

codeExamples.title: CLIP Image-Text Retrieval
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import clip
import faiss
import numpy as np

device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model, preprocess = clip.load('ViT-B/32', device=device)

# Pre-compute image embeddings
images = []  # Load your images
image_embeddings = []
for img in images:
    with torch.no_grad():
        emb = model.encode_image(preprocess(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device))
        emb /= emb.norm()
        image_embeddings.append(emb.cpu().numpy())

image_embeddings = np.vstack(image_embeddings).astype('float32')

# FAISS index
index = faiss.IndexFlatIP(512)
index.add(image_embeddings)

# Text query
query = 'a cute cat'
text_input = clip.tokenize([query]).to(device)
with torch.no_grad():
    text_emb = model.encode_text(text_input)
    text_emb /= text_emb.norm()

# Retrieve top-5
D, I = index.search(text_emb.cpu().numpy(), k=5)
print(f'Top-5 images for: {query}')
for idx in I[0]:
    print(f'  Image {idx}')
codeExamples.explanation: CLIP retrieval: Pre-compute embeddings, FAISS index, text query ile en benzer görüntüleri bul.

codeExamples.title: CLIP Fine-Tuning (Linear Probe)
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import clip

device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
clip_model, preprocess = clip.load('ViT-B/32', device=device)

# Freeze CLIP
for param in clip_model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False

# Linear classifier
classifier = nn.Linear(512, 10).to(device)  # 10 classes
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(classifier.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

# Training loop
for epoch in range(5):
    for images, labels in train_loader:
        images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            features = clip_model.encode_image(images)
            features /= features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        
        logits = classifier(features.float())
        loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    
    print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')
codeExamples.explanation: Linear probe: CLIP encoder'ı freeze et, sadece classifier eğit. Transfer learning, hızlı ve etkili.

codeExamples.title: Custom Contrastive Learning
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class MiniCLIP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.image_proj = nn.Linear(2048, embed_dim)
        self.text_proj = nn.Linear(768, embed_dim)
        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * 0.07)
    
    def forward(self, image_feats, text_feats):
        img_emb = F.normalize(self.image_proj(image_feats), dim=-1)
        txt_emb = F.normalize(self.text_proj(text_feats), dim=-1)
        
        # InfoNCE loss
        logits = (img_emb @ txt_emb.T) / self.temperature
        labels = torch.arange(len(img_emb), device=img_emb.device)
        
        loss_i2t = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
        loss_t2i = F.cross_entropy(logits.T, labels)
        loss = (loss_i2t + loss_t2i) / 2
        
        return loss

model = MiniCLIP()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)

for epoch in range(10):
    for img_feats, txt_feats in dataloader:
        loss = model(img_feats, txt_feats)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    print(f'Epoch {epoch+1}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')
codeExamples.explanation: Mini-CLIP: Contrastive learning temelleri. InfoNCE loss, temperature parameter, symmetric loss.

codeExamples.title: CLIP Prompt Engineering
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import clip

device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model, preprocess = clip.load('ViT-B/32', device=device)

class_name = 'cat'

# Multiple prompt templates
templates = [
    'a photo of a {}.',
    'a blurry photo of a {}.',
    'a rendering of a {}.',
    'a cropped photo of a {}.',
    'a photo of my {}.',
    'a close-up photo of a {}.',
]

# Ensemble
texts = [t.format(class_name) for t in templates]
text_inputs = clip.tokenize(texts).to(device)

with torch.no_grad():
    text_features = model.encode_text(text_inputs)
    text_features /= text_features.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    # Average pooling
    ensemble_features = text_features.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
    ensemble_features /= ensemble_features.norm()

print(f'Ensemble of {len(templates)} templates')
print(f'Shape: {ensemble_features.shape}')
codeExamples.explanation: Prompt engineering: Multiple templates → average embedding → daha robust. CLIP paper 80 template kullanır.

codeExamples.title: Production CLIP + FAISS
codeExamples.code:
import torch
import clip
import faiss
import numpy as np
import time

device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model, preprocess = clip.load('ViT-B/32', device=device)

# Simülasyon: 10K image embeddings
n_images = 10000
image_embeddings = np.random.randn(n_images, 512).astype('float32')
image_embeddings = image_embeddings / np.linalg.norm(image_embeddings, axis=1, keepdims=True)

# FAISS index
index = faiss.IndexFlatIP(512)
index.add(image_embeddings)

print(f'Indexed {index.ntotal} images')

# Query
query = 'a cute cat'
text_input = clip.tokenize([query]).to(device)

with torch.no_grad():
    text_features = model.encode_text(text_input)
    text_features /= text_features.norm()

query_emb = text_features.cpu().numpy()

# Retrieve
start = time.time()
D, I = index.search(query_emb, k=10)
latency = (time.time() - start) * 1000

print(f'Query: {query}')
print(f'Retrieved top-10 in {latency:.2f}ms')
for i, (dist, idx) in enumerate(zip(D[0], I[0])):
    print(f'  {i+1}. Image {idx}: {dist:.4f}')
codeExamples.explanation: Production: Pre-compute embeddings, FAISS index, <100ms retrieval for 10K images. Scalable to millions.

quiz.question: CLIP'in temel prensibi nedir?
quiz.explanation: CLIP contrastive learning kullanır. 400M görüntü-metin çifti, eşleşenler yakın, eşleşmeyenler uzak.

quiz.question: Zero-shot classification nasıl çalışır?
options: Class names → prompt → text embedding → similarity
quiz.explanation: Zero-shot: Class names'i 'a photo of a {class}' ile encode et, görüntü ile similarity hesapla, argmax.

quiz.question: InfoNCE loss nedir?
options: Contrastive loss: Positive pairs yakın, negative uzak
quiz.explanation: InfoNCE: Batch'te N görüntü, N metin → N² pair. Positive pair'i seç (classification). Symmetric loss.

quiz.question: Prompt engineering neden önemli?
quiz.explanation: Prompt engineering kritik: 'a photo of...' vs domain-specific → %5-10 fark. Ensemble daha robust.

quiz.question: ViT avantajı nedir?
options: Büyük modellerde daha iyi scale olur
quiz.explanation: Vision Transformer: Büyük modellerde (ViT-L, ViT-H) ResNet'ten daha iyi scale olur, daha yüksek accuracy.

quiz.question: CLIP limitasyonları?
quiz.explanation: CLIP limitations: Counting, spatial relations, fine-grained details, compositional understanding, bias.

quiz.question: Image-text retrieval nasıl?
quiz.explanation: Retrieval: Offline image embeddings → FAISS index → query time text embedding → top-K retrieval.

quiz.question: Production challenge?
quiz.explanation: Production: Latency (vision encoder 150ms), storage (1M × 512 × 4B = 2GB), FAISS ANN, bias & safety.

Positive pairs yakın, negative uzak. InfoNCE loss. Batch N görüntü, N metin → N² pair, N positive.
Eğitilmediği kategorileri tanır. Class names → text embedding → cosine similarity. Fine-tuning yok!
Contrastive loss: Positive pair'i N pair arasından seç. Temperature τ. Symmetric: image→text + text→image.
Template seçimi accuracy'yi %5-10 etkiler. Domain-specific templates. Ensemble: 80 template average → robust.
CLIP vision encoder. Patches → transformer. ResNet'ten daha iyi scale. ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14.
Pre-compute embeddings → FAISS → text query → top-K. <100ms for 1M images. Google Images, Pinterest.

commonMistakes.why: Contrastive learning ile eğitilmiş, direkt supervised fine-tune performansı düşürebilir, overfitting riski.
commonMistakes.fix: Linear probe tercih et (freeze encoders). Eğer çok veri varsa full fine-tune ama learning rate düşük (1e-5), batch size büyük (256+).

commonMistakes.why: Domain-specific dataset'lerde 'a photo of a...' suboptimal. Satellite images için %5-10 daha kötü.
commonMistakes.fix: Domain-specific prompts: Medical, satellite, retail için özel template'ler. Ensemble: 80 template average. A/B test.

commonMistakes.why: Class names sabit. Her görüntü için aynı text'leri encode etmek gereksiz compute. Latency artar.
commonMistakes.fix: Pre-compute text embeddings: Offline encode, disk/memory'de sakla. Inference: Sadece image encode, pre-computed yükle.

commonMistakes.why: Tek tek encode çok yavaş (150ms/image). 1000 görüntü → 150 saniye. GPU underutilized.
commonMistakes.fix: Batch inference: 32-128 batch → 200ms for 32 images (6ms/image). Async batching. TensorRT/ONNX. 10x-20x hızlanma.

commonMistakes.why: 1M image brute-force O(N·d) → çok yavaş (saniyeler). Real-time imkansız.
commonMistakes.fix: FAISS ANN: IndexIVFFlat (10x hızlı, %99 recall), IndexHNSW (daha hızlı), PQ (8x compression). 1M images → <50ms.

commonMistakes.why: Limitations: Counting, spatial reasoning, fine-grained, compositional. Kullanıcılar hayal kırıklığı.
commonMistakes.fix: Realistic expectations. CLIP strength'leri kullan (object recognition, retrieval). Hybrid: CLIP + specialized model. Upgrade: GPT-4V, LLaVA.

commonMistakes.why: CLIP internet'ten öğrendi (filtrelenmemiş). Stereotypes, NSFW, misinformation. Legal, ethical risk.
commonMistakes.fix: Bias evaluation: Red-teaming, fairness metrics, content filtering, NSFW classifier, human-in-the-loop, monitoring.
